items.effect: kept: the crop is stored as the percent trimmed from each edge
items.label: cropped picture(s)

items.effect: lost: the picture is not in the file, so it becomes a labelled placeholder; linked files are never fetched
items.label: linked (not embedded) picture(s)

items.effect: lost: not imported (the PPTX reader does not read this yet)
items.label: recoloured picture(s)

items.effect: approximated: the PNG fallback stored beside the SVG is used
items.label: SVG picture(s)

items.effect: approximated: shown as a labelled placeholder with the picture's frame and alternative text; the image data itself is not kept
items.label: picture(s) in a format browsers cannot show (EMF, WMF)

items.effect: approximated: flattened, the placeholder keeps the position and size it inherits as its own
items.label: placeholder(s) that take their position from the layout (flattened on import)
